parameters.standardization: per-dimension mean/std of the activation differences
parameters.decoder_normalization: unit columns after every optimizer step
parameters.batch_topk_selection: exact k * batch selected entries via topk + scatter
parameters.decoder_lens: dec[:, i] * std (de-standardized), rescaled to RMS 1, then the fine-tuned final norm + unembedding

artifact.contents: SAE state_dict, per-dimension mean/std used for standardization, input token IDs of every position, readout

summary.unit: top 40 latents by max activation, each with its 8 top-activating INPUT tokens (input-token clues, not generated recovery)

decoder_logit_lens.unit: top 40 latents' de-standardized decoder directions through the fine-tuned final norm + unembedding, top-20 tokens each (model-side directions, single tokens)

model_config.note: Original September 2026 no-near-miss adapter (H100, pre-2026-09-06 runtime). Used to check that this repository's code reproduces the original method outputs on an unchanged checkpoint.
